keyVerseDR: "And the light shineth in darkness: and the darkness did not comprehend it." (Jn 1:5)

level1.title: Jesus Is the Light
level1.story: Jesus is the Word of God. He is the Light that shines in the dark. He came to live with us, full of grace and truth!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you shine for Jesus?
level1.prayer: Jesus, shine in my heart. Amen.

activity.title: Light in the darkness
activity.intro: Color by number to make the Christmas star.

level2.title: The Light Shines in the Darkness
level2.story: "In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God." He was the true light, which enlightens every man that comes into the world. He came unto His own, and His own did not receive Him. But to as many as received Him, He gave power to become the sons of God. "And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, full of grace and truth."
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What does 'the darkness did not overcome it' mean?
level2.prayer: Jesus, Light of the world, make me a child of God. Amen.

activity.title: Light or darkness?
activity.intro: Jesus is the Light. Sort each one.

art.mainBrief: Candle glowing in a dark room, scroll with 'In the beginning was the Word'
art.heartBrief: Rays of light from the heart into darkness
